title: Wave planning counts a slice with placeholder spec sections as specified

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-11: after `slicer decide s457` cleared needs-owner, `ork wave suggest slicer` put s457 in Wave 5, though its Failing tests body is "Written after Q1 and Q2" and its Implement says to wait for the owner's answers before writing the steps; `slicer check` warned "s457 / Failing tests: no backticked test name". s453, whose sections were empty, was listed as Unspecified. Wanted: treat a slice whose Failing tests names no backticked test as unspecified in the wave plan, or have `decide` say the slice still needs specifying.
